title: Filming: With A Little Luck by Wings | 1978
content:
Wings filmed promotional clips for their songs ‘With A Little Luck’ and ‘London Town’ on 20 and 21 March 1978.

They were directed by Michael Lindsay-Hogg, who had worked with The Beatles and also directed Wings’ video for ‘Mull Of Kintyre’. This two-day shoot took place at Twickenham Film Studios, where The Beatles and Lindsay-Hogg had made parts of Let It Be.

For ‘With A Little Luck’, the band’s current single, the radio edit was used for the soundtrack. Paul McCartney was filmed playing his Rickenbacker bass, flanked by Denny Laine and Linda McCartney, both of whom were playing keyboards. To the left was new drummer Steve Holley, who was miming to Joe English’s playing.

‘With a Little Luck’ is a simple video, and is meant to be an optimistic one. We have them playing with a tree behind them, and there are some kids dancing. And then there are some little kids who were on the shoot as well. We had them just to make it seem a joyous occasion, and also because Paul likes kids a lot. He understands them.
Michael Lindsay-Hogg, 24 May 2020
The McCartney Legacy: Volume 2: 1974-80
